QuestInfo.name: Memory Loss
QuestInfo.0: #p2151003# suggests doing a few favors to get people used to you. Perhaps #p2151003# could use some help?
QuestInfo.1: #p2151003# suggests doing a few favors to get people used to you. Perhaps #p2151003# could use some help?
QuestInfo.2: #p2151003# wanted to know more about the Black Wings and Gelimer, but you didn't have much to share.

0.0: What is it, #b#h0##k?\r\n#L0#What can I do to help?#l\n#k
0.1: I am certain you will figure that out for yourself. I would like to ask you a question, though. #bWhat do you remember#k?

yes.0: Give me a moment before we talk. I have one thing to sort out first...

no.0: Did I hit a touchy subject? I can wait if you need to collect yourself.

1.0: Now then, you told me your memories were clouded. What do you remember?\r\n#L0##bNothing. Nothing at all...#l\n#k
1.1: You must remember something. Think.\r\n#L0##bThe oldest memory I have is waking in the laboratory. I have no recollection prior to that.#l\n#k
1.2:
Interesting. What do you know about #bGelimer#k and the
#bBlack Wings#k?
#L0##bWhat are the Black Wings?#l
#k
1.3: Gelimer never spoke of the Black Wings? They fund his research... they built that laboratory. He even reports to their leader, #bOrchid#k.\r\n#L0##bI apologize. My whole life, I've only known the other Xenoroids and Professor Gelimer.#l\n#k
1.4: Don't be sorry. It's possible that we assumed too much about the importance of that lab. But I was sure #bOrchid or one of the other Black Wings#k would have paid you a visit. Something strange is going on... Tell me what you know about Gelimer.\r\n#L0##bVery little. Roo-D would know more about him than I do.#l\n#k
1.5: Rudy? Who's Rudy?\r\n#L0##bUnit R-0-0-D. She's the small Xenoroid that escaped with me. She has two protruding ears.#l\n#k
1.6: Oh, the robo-rabbit?\r\n#L0##bMy memory banks indicate that she shares a design with lagomorphic creatures, yes. She was Dr. Gelimer's lab helper, responsible for training and testing.#l\n#k
1.7: What kind of training and testing? \r\n#L0##bMostly combat-oriented, though we did focus on infiltration quite regularly.#l\n#k
1.8: Gelimer was aiming to make you into the perfect battle machine. Maybe he intended that for #bthe child#k as well...

yes.0: Thank you for the information. We can discuss further at another time.
